With six years of experience as a backend engineer and two years leading engineering teams, I have architected scalable systems and guided technical strategy across complex product domains. At Northwind Robotics, I owned the order-routing service—built with TypeScript on Node.js and PostgreSQL—which processed approximately two million events daily. My work emphasized performance, reliability, and clean architecture, aligning closely with the demands of high-throughput data platforms.

As engineering lead at Vertex Logistics, I managed a team of five engineers spanning dispatch and billing systems, fostering collaboration and technical excellence across product lines. I led a nine-month initiative to decompose a monolithic application into event-driven microservices using a Strangler-fig pattern, achieving the transition with zero customer-visible downtime. This effort reduced p99 checkout latency from 1.9 seconds to 340 milliseconds through targeted optimization and incremental modernization.

I bring deep hands-on expertise in PostgreSQL—including schema design, query tuning, and logical replication—as well as production experience with TypeScript and Node.js over six years. I have used Kubernetes and Terraform for reliable, infrastructure-as-code deployments. These skills, combined with my track record in system modernization and team leadership, position me to contribute effectively to Silvermark Labs’ Data Platform as a Staff Engineer.
